senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (शलते)
1 To move, to shake, to tremble or stir.
2 To cover.
(-शलति)
To go, to move to or towards.
r. 10th cl. (शालयति)
To praise.

mn. (-लः-लं)
The quill of a porcupine.
m. (-लः)
1 A name of BHṚṄGI, ŚIVA'S attendant.
2 BRAHMĀ.
3 A kind of field.
4 A dart, a spear.
5 A stake.
E.
शल to go, aff. अच्.

m. (-ल्लः)
A frog.
n. (-ल्लं)
Bark, rind.
E.
शल to go, लच् aff.

(ऋ) शालृ r. 1st cl. (शालते)
1 To flatter, to praise.
2 To boast.

m. (-लः)
1 A kind of fish, (Ophiocephalus wrahl, HAM.)
2 The celebrated sovereign SĀLIVĀHANA.
3 The name of a river.
f. (-ला)
1 A house.
2 A hall.
3 A large branch of a tree.
E.
शल to go, घञ् aff. or शाल to praise, aff. अच्; in several of the meanings it is also written, साल.

r. 1st cl. (सलति)
1 To go, to move.
2 To shake.

n. (-लं)
Water.
E.
षल to go, अच् aff.

m. (-लः)
1 A wall surrounding a building, &c.
2 A tree in general.
3 The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.)
4 A fish (Ophiocephalus Wrahl, HAM.)
f. (-ला)
A house; more usually शाला.
E.
षल to go, घञ् aff.; also शाल.

m. (-कः)
A spider.
E.
शल to go, aff. वुन्.

f. (-का)
1 A javelin, a dart.
2 An arrow.
3 A porcupine.
4 The rib of an umbrella, the bar of a cage, &c. or any such small stake, rod, peg, or pin: it is applied also in common use, to a thin slip of bambu, serving when tipped with sulphur for a match; to a round pointed piece of wood or bambu serving as a toothpick, to a similar piece employed as a tent or probe, or to a larger one used as a ruler, &c.
5 A bone.
6 An oblong quadrangular piece of ivory or bone used in playing a particular game, a domino.
7 A fibrous stick used as a brush or pencil.
8 A thorny shrub, (Vangueria spinosa.)
9 The Sārika, (Turdus Gosalica, BUC.)
E.
शल to go, Uṇādi aff. आकन्.

m. (-कः)
1 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)
n. (-कं)
Bark, rind.
f. (-की)
1 A porcupine.
2 The gum Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.)
E.
शल to go, aff. क्वुन्, deriv. irr.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A king.
2 A sort of salt.
E.
शल to go, Uṇādi aff. अङ्गच्.

m. (-भः)
1 A grasshopper.
2 A locust.
E.
शल to go, अभच् Uṇādi aff.: see शरभ.

nf. (-लं-ली)
The quill of a porcupine.
E.
शल to go, to project, aff. कलच्, fem. aff. ङीष्.

ind.
Beat at a game played with pieces of stick.
E.
शलाका a match, &c., and परि implying in this and similar compounds, reverse.

m. plu. (-षाः)
Sixty-three persons considered by the Jainas as sacred and divine, viz. the 24 Jinas, 12 Cakravartīs, 9 Vāsudevas, 9 Baladevas, and 9 Prativāsudevas.

m. (-टः)
A cart load, considered as twenty times one hundred Palas.
E.
शॄ to injure, aff. आटन्, and the र changed to ल.

mfn. (-टुः-टुः-टु)
Unripe, moist, (as fruit.)
m. (-टुः)
A kind of root.
E.
शल to go, आटु aff.

m. (-लिः)
A camel.

n. (-लु)
A sort of perfume.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Purchased with or procured for the substance termed Śalālu.
E.
शलालु as above, and ष्टन् aff.; also with ठक् aff. शालालुक, &c.

n. (-ल्कं)
1 A part, a portion.
2 Bark, rind.
3 The scale of a fish.
E.
शल to go, Uṇādi aff. कन्.

n. (-लं)
1 The scale of a fish.
2 Bark, rind.
E.
शल to go, कलच् aff.

m. (-ली)
A fish.
E.
शल्कल a scale, and इनि aff.

m. (-ल्की)
A fish.
E.
शल्क a scale, and इनि aff.

r. 1st cl. (शल्भते)
1 To praise, to flatter or coax.
2 To talk, to boast.

mf. (-लिः-ली)
The silk-cotton tree: see शाल्मलि.

mf. (-लिः-ली)
1 The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.)
2 One of the seven Dvīpas, islands or great divisions of the known continent; denominated from the tree first mentioned, said to grow there: it is surrounded by the sea of Ghee or clarified butter.
E.
शल to go, causal form, क्विप् aff. शाल् exuding, emitting, मल to hold, aff. इन्, and ङीष् optionally added; also with अच् aff. शाल्मल, and with the first vowel short, शल्मलि, &c.

mn. (-ल्यः-ल्यं)
A dart, a javelin.
n. (-ल्यं)
1 A bambu rod or stake.
2 Any stake or thorn.
3 An arrow.
4 An iron crow.
5 Sin, crime.
6 Difficulty, embarrassment, distress.
7 An arrow, a thorn, or other extraneous substance which has lodged in the body.
8 Abuse, defamation.
9 Poison.
m. (-ल्यः)
1 A thorny shrub, (Vangueria spinosa.)
2 A porcupine.
3 A hedgehog.
4 A peg, a pin, &c.
5 A boundary.
6 A king, the maternal uncle of YUDHIṢṬHIRA.
E.
शल to go, aff. यत् or य Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A stake, a thorn.
2 A dart, a pike.
3 A porcupine.
4 A hedgehog.
5 A thorny shrub, (Vangueria spinosa.)
E.
शल्य as above, and कन् added.

m. (-ण्ठः)
A porcupine.
E.
शल्य a stake, and कण्ठ the throat.

f. (-या)
The extraction of extraneous substances lodged in the body.
E.
शल्य, and क्रिया act.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Shooting arrows.
2 Set with stakes.
3 Harassed with difficulties, &c.
E.
शल्य, and मतुप् aff.

n. (-ङ्गं)
The part by which an arrow or the like lodged in the body is to be laid hold of for its extraction.
E.
शल्य, and वारङ्ग the place of seizure.

n. (-स्त्रं)
That part of Surgery which treats of the extraction of extraneous substances lodged in the body.
E.
शल्य, and शास्त्र science.

m. (-रिः)
YUDHIṢṬHIRA.
E.
शल्य the prince, and अरि an enemy.

m. (-रः)
1 Extraction of foreign substances from the body.
2 Cleansing or purifying a new house.
E.
शल्य, and उद्घार taking out or away.

m. (-वः)
Incense, Olibanum.
E.
शल्लकी the Boswellia thurifera, and द्रव exudation.

m. (-ल्वः)
A country so named in the north of India.
E.
शल to go, क्वन् aff., more usually शाल्व.

m. plu. (-ल्वाः)
The inhabitants of one of the central divisions of India.

mfn. (-ल्वः-ल्वी-ल्वं)
Belonging to the Sālva country: the word is more usually read, शाल्व.
m. (-ल्वः)
1 The name of a demon, the enemy of VIṢṆU.
2 The name of a country or place.
m. pl. (-ल्वाः)
The people.

m. (-नः)
1 The name of a saint.
2 ŚIVA'S attendant NANDI.

f. (-सूः)
The mother of VYĀSA.

m. (-जः)
A kind of fish, the Śāl or Sol, (Ophicephalus wrahl, HAM.)

mfn. (-ज्जः-ज्जा-ज्जं)
Bashful, modest, ashamed.
E.
स with, लज्जा shame.

m. (-सः)
Resin, the resinous exudation of the Śāl or Shorea robusta.
E.
शाल the Śāl tree, and निर्य्यास exudation.

m. (-सः)
The resinous exudation of the Śāl tree.
E.
साल the tree, and निर्य्यास exudation.

f. (-र्णी)
A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.)
E.
शाल the Śāl, and पर्ण a leaf, aff. ङीष्, having similar leaves; also सालपर्णी.

f. (-र्णी)
A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum); also शालपर्णी.

f. (-का)
1 A doll, a puppet.
2 A whore, a harlot.
E.
कन् added to the following.

f. (-का)
A doll, a puppet.
E.
साल the Śāl tree or its wood, भञ्ज to rub, वुन् aff., fem. form.

f. (-ञ्जी)
A doll, a puppet.
E.
शाल Śāl wood, भञ्ज to rub, (to plane, &c., in order to make dolls,) affs. अच्, and ङीष्; also with कन् added शालभञ्जिका.

m. (-ष्टः)
Resin, the resin of the Śāl tree, used as incense, &c.
E.
शाल the Śāl tree, and वेष्ट exudation.

m. (-ष्टः)
Turpentine, or the resinous exudation of the Śāl tree.
E.
साल the tree, and वेष्ट exudation.

m. (-रः)
1 A tree.
2 Asafætida; also सालसार.

m. (-की)
1 A surgeon.
2 A barber.
3 A spearman, &c.
E.
शलाका a probe, a dart, &c. अण् aff. of reference, and इनि poss. aff. added.

f. (-ङ्की)
A doll, a puppet.
E.
शाला a hall, अकि to go, affs. अच्, and ङीष्.

mn. (-रः-रं)
A hollow earthen cup or saucer.
E.
शाला a house, जॄ to become old, अच् aff.

f. (-ञ्चिः)
A creeping plant, the leaves of which are used as a vegetable, (Achyranthes triandra.)
E.
शाला a house, अञ्च to go, aff. इन्.

f. (-नी)
A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.)
E.
शाल the Śāl tree, आङ् before नी to get, (to resemble in the leaf,) aff. क्विप्.

m. (-गः)
A Shakal.
E.
शाला a house, and मृग a deer.

n. (-रं)
1 A ladder, a flight of stairs or steps.
2 A birdcage.
3 The claw of an elephant.
E.
शाला a house, ऋ to go, aff. अच्.

n. (-रं)
A pin, a bracket, or shelf, projecting from a wall.
E.
साल a wall, ऋ to go, अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A monkey.
2 A dog.
3 A Shakal.
4 A deer.
5 A cat.
E.
शाला a house, वृक a wolf.

m. (-कः)
1 A dog.
2 A wolf.
3 A jackal.
E.
साला a house, and वृक a wolf, more usually शालावृक.

n. (-लि)
1 Rice in general, but especially in two classes; one like white rice growing in deep water, and the other a red sort, requiring only a moist soil: there are a great many varieties of this grain.
2 The civet or pole cat.
E.
शाड to float or swim, aff. इन, and ड changed to ल.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating or belonging to a hall, the Śāl tree, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 A weaver.
2 A village of artificers.
3 A toll, a tax.
f. (-का)
A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.)
E.
शाल the Śāl tree, कन् fem. form, aff. of comparison; or शाला a hall, ठक् aff.

m. (-ञ्चः)
A creeper, the leaf of which is used as a vegetable, (Achyranthes triandra, Rox.)

f. (-ता)
1 Possessing, having.
2 Confidence in, relying upon.
E.
शालिन्, and तल् aff. or with त्व, शालित्वं.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
1 Belonging to a house, domestic, &c.
2 Possessing, having.
3 Shining or resplendent with.
E.
शाल a house, and इनि aff.; in the second form it is the same as शील; the इ being changed to आ when used in composition.

n. (-णं)
Abuse, reproach.

n. (-ष्टं)
Crystal.
E.
शालि rice, and पिष्ट ground.

m. (-नः)
A sovereign of India, whose capital was Pratiṣṭhāna in the Dekhin, and institutor of the era now called Śakā, beginning 76 or 78 years after CRIST.
E.
शालि from शाल the Śāl tree, or a proper name, that of a Yakṣa transformed to a lion, on which the prince rode when an infant, and वाहन vehicle.

m. (-त्रः)
A horse.
E.
शालि rice, corn, and होत्र an oblation; also with इनि added शालिहोत्रिन् m. (-त्री)

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Ashamed, bashful.
2 Like, resembling.
m. (-नः)
An opulent householder, one who devotes his attention to worldly affairs.
E.
शाला a house, ख aff. (fit or worthy to enter it.)

n. (-त्वं)
Modesty.
E.
त्व added to the last, also with तल्, शालीनता.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Immodest.
E.
शालीनत्व, and विवर्ज्जित devoid of.

m. (-लुः)
1 An astringent substance.
2 A sort of perfume, commonly called Cor.
3 A frog.
n. (-लु)
The root of the water lily.
E.
शॄ to hurt, उ aff., and र changed to ल.

n. (-कं)
The root of a lotus: see the next.

n. (-कं)
The esculent root of the different kinds of Nymphæa or water lily.
E.
शल to go, to shake, Uṇādi aff. ऊकन्; also with a short vowel शालुक.

m. (-रः)
A frog.
E.
शल to go, ऊलच् aff. and the radical vowel made long; also शालुर.

m. (-रः)
A frog.
E.
षल to go, ऊरच् aff.; the first vowel made long, and the initial changed; also शालुर.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Fit for rice, (a field, &c.)
m. (-यः)
A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa.)
E.
शालि rice, and ढंक् aff.

m. (-यः)
A sort of fennel or dill, (Anethum sowa.)
E.
see शालेय.

m. (-यः)
A name of PĀṆINI, the inspired grammarian.
E.
शाला a house, the house of his preceptor, उत्तरीय latter, last; having been expelled it for stupidity, and acquiring his subsequent science by his worship of ŚIVA.

m. (-लः)
1 The silk cotton tree.
2 One of the Dvīpas to divisions of the continent.
3 The gum of the silk cotton tree.
E.
see the next.

m. (-ली)
GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU.
f. (-लिनी)
The silk cotton tree.

m. (-ष्टः)
The gum of the silk cotton tree.
E.
शाल्मलि the tree, and वेष्ट exudation; also with कन् added शाल्मलीवेष्टक.

n. (-लं)
Water.
E.
षल to go, इलच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Wanton, sportive.
E.
स for सह with, लीला sport.

m. (-लः)
An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.)
E.
सलिल water, and कुन्तल hair.

f. (-या)
The funeral rite of washing the corpse.
E.
सलिल, and क्रिया act.

n. (-जं)
A lotus.
E.
सलिल water, and ज born.

m. (-धिः)
The ocean.
E.
सलिल, and निधि store.

m. (-यः)
Current, stream.
E.
सलिल, and रय speed.

m. (-शिः)
Any piece of water.
E.
सलिल, and राशि heap.

m. (-नः)
Submarine fire.
E.
सलिल water, and इन्धन inflaming.

f. (-की)
The gum Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.)
E.
सल to go, वुन् aff., and the ल doubled; also शल्लकी.

n. (-मं)
A stone, a species of ammonite common in the Gandhak river, and worshipped by the Vaiṣṇavas, as a type of VIṢṆU.
E.
स with, अर a ring, ग्राम multitude.

m. (-नः)
The resin of the Śāl tree.

n. (-ष्पं)
A shrub, (Hibiscus mutabilis).
E.
साल the Śāl tree, and पुष्प a flower.

m. (-सः)
The resinous juice of the Śāl tree.
E.
साल the Śāl, and रस juice.

m. (-नः)
The sovereign SĀLAVĀHANA.
E.
साल the Śāl tree, and वाहन a vehicle: see शालवाहन, &c.

n. (-ङ्गं)
The upper part or coping of a wall.
E.
साल a wall, and शृङ्ग horn or summit.

f. (-री)
A female overcome or won in battle.
E.
साला a house, कृ to make, ट aff.

m. (-यः)
A name of PĀṆINI.
E.
also read शालातुरीय.

n. (-क्यं)
Habitation with, residing with, (especially with the deity.)
E.
स with, लोक world, ष्यञ् aff.

f. (-ता)
Habitation, state of abiding or dwelling.
E.
तल् added to the last.

m. (-हा)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
साल्व a demon, and हन् destroyer.

m. (-कः)
A sort of bird.
